app.title: Unsloth Qwen3.8-27B Quantizations – Dynamic v3.1 Update
app.description: Quantized Qwen3.8‑27B model with dynamic quantization, packaged for fast inference with Unsloth’s lightweight runtime.
proposed_tests: download the Qwen3.8‑27B quantized checkpoint from the provided URL
load the model in Python with unsloth.load_model() and generate a short completion
measure latency for a 50‑token prompt and compare to baseline 4‑bit quantization
run unsloth-cli run --model qwen3.8 --prompt "Hello" and check exit code
